title: Diagnose a blocked high-priority task
description: A high-priority control task waits for a mutex held by a low-priority logging task. An unrelated medium-priority task runs continuously. Explain the failure and discuss priority inheritance, lock duration, and whether a semaphore is an equivalent replacement.
prompt: A high-priority control task waits for a mutex held by a low-priority logging task. An unrelated medium-priority task runs continuously. Explain the failure and discuss priority inheritance, lock duration, and whether a semaphore is an equivalent replacement.
constraints: State assumptions and separate measurements from guarantees.
rubric: Identify the medium task delaying the mutex owner.
Describe priority inheritance and its limits.
Discuss bounded critical sections and avoiding blocking I/O under the mutex.
follow_ups: How would you measure worst-case blocking on the target?
hints: Write down the boundary cases before choosing an implementation.
Use explicit integer widths and keep intermediate values in range.
